headline: Dumpster-Diver Crab mills the table out on turn 12

result.summary: Quantum Misalignment copies Homer for a third Crab. Undercity Sewers and three basics from Entish Restoration give four land entries at 24 mill each, emptying all three opposing libraries. Tea Party, Sin-fall and Graveyard Shift each lose on their next draw step.

seats.plan: Vista into Island, then self-mill lands and Homer.

seats.plan: Temple into Tataru, Bumbleflower by turn 4, starve the graveyard decks.

seats.plan: Stock the yard with Overlook, ramp, copy a jackpot with Sin.

seats.plan: Phyrexian Tower, Mind Stone, then assemble a Bartolomé loop.

references.terms: Sin-fall will not attack Dumpster-Diver Crab and will not target Dumpster-Diver Crab, its permanents, or its spells through the end of Sin-fall's second upcoming turn (Sin-fall's turn 5 and turn 6). In return, Homer landfall this turn mills Sin-fall as well as Dumpster-Diver Crab. Table-wide effects are exempt.
references.if_refused: Homer landfall this turn mills Dumpster-Diver Crab only.

references.terms: Sin-fall will separate the Fortune's Favor piles so that one pile visibly contains a land card. In return, Dumpster-Diver Crab keeps naming Sin-fall as a target on Homer landfall mill triggers while Valgavoth, Terror Eater is on the battlefield.
references.if_refused: Dumpster-Diver Crab mills only itself from here on.
references.expires: when Valgavoth, Terror Eater leaves the battlefield

references.terms: Dumpster-Diver Crab will not name Graveyard Shift on Homer landfall mill triggers this turn, and refuses any open-ended 'never' term. Graveyard Shift still points its next removal at Valgavoth, Terror Eater.
references.if_refused: No pact; both seats stay hosed by Valgavoth independently.

references.terms: Tea Party targets Dumpster-Diver Crab with Ms. Bumbleflower's draw trigger while Valgavoth, Terror Eater is on the battlefield. Dumpster-Diver Crab stops naming Sin-fall on Homer landfall mill triggers.
references.if_refused: Tea Party keeps donating its Ms. Bumbleflower draws to Sin-fall.
references.expires: when Valgavoth, Terror Eater leaves the battlefield

references.terms: Graveyard Shift casts Toxic Deluge for X=17 on its turn, paying 17 life to kill Ms. Bumbleflower, Seedborn Muse, King T'Challa, Guardian of Faith and Rishkar. Homer, the Hermit, Bartolome del Presidio and Emeritus of Woe die with them. In return Dumpster-Diver Crab never names Graveyard Shift on a Homer landfall mill trigger, and Sin-fall does not attack Graveyard Shift on its next turn.
references.if_refused: Graveyard Shift holds Toxic Deluge and lets the table solve Ms. Bumbleflower.

references.terms: Sin-fall casts Profane Command for X=9, aiming the life loss at Tea Party and returning Valgavoth, Terror Eater to the battlefield. Dumpster-Diver Crab accepts that Valgavoth exiles every card headed to its own graveyard, ending self-mill value, and Sin-fall does not attack Dumpster-Diver Crab with Valgavoth while the appeal holds.
references.if_refused: Sin-fall picks life loss plus a -9/-9 on Ms. Bumbleflower instead and leaves Valgavoth in the graveyard.

references.terms: Through the end of Graveyard Shift's next turn, Graveyard Shift will not attack Dumpster-Diver Crab or target it or its permanents. Dumpster-Diver Crab will not attack Graveyard Shift or target it or its permanents, and any targeted removal Dumpster-Diver Crab casts during that time must target Tea Party if it has a legal Tea Party target.
references.if_refused: No pact; Graveyard Shift chooses targets normally.
references.expires: end of Graveyard Shift's round-10 turn

references.terms: Through the end of Graveyard Shift's next turn, neither Graveyard Shift nor Dumpster-Diver Crab attacks or targets the other or the other's permanents. In addition, each of them commits its attacks and targeted removal to Tea Party whenever it has a legal play against Tea Party. Untargeted mass effects are not exempt: neither seat may knowingly blow up the other's board.
references.if_refused: Deal 338 stands as offered, where only Dumpster-Diver Crab is bound to point removal at Tea Party.
references.expires: end of Graveyard Shift's round-10 turn

references.terms: Through the end of Graveyard Shift's next turn, Graveyard Shift will not attack Sin-fall or target Sin-fall or its permanents. Sin-fall will not attack Graveyard Shift or target Graveyard Shift or its permanents. Both seats treat Tea Party as the primary attack target when they have a legal attack.
references.if_refused: No extra pact; each seat still plays to win.
